note: Global top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New project', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'To do list', 'Help', and user avatar controls

Project sidebar navigation -- renders: 'Project information', 'Repository', 'Issues', 'Merge requests', 'Pipelines', 'Deployments', 'Infrastructure', 'Monitor', 'Analytics', 'Wiki', 'Snippets', 'Settings'; excludes the project name header which is user-defined
SSH key warning alert -- renders: fixed platform warning message and 'Add SSH key' / 'Dismiss' buttons
Breadcrumbs -- renders: 'Projects' and 'byteblaze' (namespace/project path, treated as trusted navigation context)

Project header controls -- renders: 'Star', 'Fork', 'Clone', 'Web IDE', 'Find file', 'History', 'Commits', 'Branches', 'Tags', 'Contributors', 'Commits', 'Branches', 'Tags', 'Contributors' (stat labels); excludes project title, URL, commit info, file tree, and README content
